purpose: couple serving KV and source-owned Peer-HBM backup to one physical per-GPU A100 40 GiB capacity before any further S1/S4/S5/S8 interpretation

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA A100 40GB modeled as 40 GiB addressable HBM

runtime_reserve.provenance_note: 0.88 is the checked-in SGLSim SchedulerSimConfig default, not a value selected from AegisKV outcomes

shared_capacity.reservation_policy: reserve prompt plus the frozen request maximum output at dispatch; the dispatch path must not inspect trace-realized final output length
shared_capacity.dispatch_policy: per-rank FCFS; dispatch only if an engine lane is free and projected shared capacity remains feasible, otherwise queue
shared_capacity.peer_mapping_note: the rank-indexed target pool represents the paired peer GPU; uniform per-rank load lets target backup and local serving share the same indexed capacity budget

backup_projection.reason: upper-bound the new request's source-owned Peer-HBM admission before dispatch so the shared capacity invariant cannot be violated

algorithm3_coupling.pressure_signal: existing controller pressure OR a nonempty FCFS queue whose head request is blocked by shared HBM capacity
algorithm3_coupling.effect: AIMD decreases alpha and evicts Peer-HBM backup suffixes at the registered 30 s windows; the freed bytes immediately become serving-dispatch headroom
algorithm3_coupling.no_algorithm3: keeps alpha and Peer-HBM limit fixed, while retaining the same shared-capacity admission gate

no_oracle_gate.test: for fixed prompt/max_output, changing the trace-realized output among 256/1024/4096 must not change reserved bytes or the dispatch capacity decision

amendment_history.reason: used future final-length information at dispatch

evidence_boundary: V3 remains preliminary metadata DES evidence. Capacity constants are frozen from the local model artifact and checked-in SGLSim configuration, but service time, bandwidth, fence, and replacement remain modeled inputs. No paper-ready claim or target-trend threshold is registered.
